definitions.explanation: The state of things as they actually exist.

examples.japanese: {現実|げんじつ}を{受|う}け{入|い}れる。
{現実|げんじつ}と{理想|りそう}の{差|さ}
examples.english: The gap between reality and ideals.

examples.japanese: {現実|げんじつ}{的|てき}な{考|かんが}え{方|かた}

notes:
{現実|げんじつ} refers to reality.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {現実|げんじつ}を{見|み}る (to face reality)
- {現実|げんじつ}{的|てき} (realistic)
- {現実|げんじつ}{離|ばな}れ (out of touch with reality)

CONTRAST:
- {現実|げんじつ} vs {理想|りそう} (reality vs ideal)
- {現実|げんじつ} vs {夢|ゆめ} (reality vs dream)
